premises.text: 3D printing is revolutionizing various industries and is a growing market
premises.evidence_span: 3D printing is revolutionizing medicine, architecture, and even the military. 3D printing is a billion-dollar market now and is expected to triple in five years.

premises.text: Designers can sell 3D printable files through a marketplace
premises.evidence_span: creating a marketplace where designers can sell professional-level 3D printable files, rather than just giving them away on sites like Thingiverse.

premises.text: Consumers can customize and order 3D printed products easily
premises.evidence_span: With 3DLT, it's built right in. To customize, you'll just enter in your size and width, and voila, custom stilettos fitted perfectly for you.

premises.text: 3DLT allows consumers to choose when, where, and how products are manufactured
premises.evidence_span: We give you the power to choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured.

premises.text: 3D printing will shift from prototyping to finished products in the near future
premises.evidence_span: Today, 70% of 3D print is for prototyping and industrial use. But by 2020, the model will flip.

premises.text: 3DLT can provide cheaper, greener, and better quality products than mass-manufactured goods
premises.evidence_span: Files, blueprints, products that are cheaper, greener, and better quality than anything that is currently mass-manufactured.

value.text: Consumers gain access to a diverse range of customizable 3D printed products
value.evidence_span: From frames to furniture to sneakers and stilettos, we've got them.

notes: Exclusions include funding details and promotional offers.
